day1_failed_queries_evaluation.day1_failure_root_cause: Cross-product contamination; lexical overlap with 'office expenses' pulled unrelated HisabDo blog article.
day1_failed_queries_evaluation.routing_decision: Deterministic Negative Boundary Fallback (Physical address not published; cite /contact)

day1_failed_queries_evaluation.day1_failure_root_cause: Weak secondary filtering allowed consumer HisabDo media emails to appear in top-3 candidates.
day1_failed_queries_evaluation.routing_decision: Direct Grounded Generation (Official email xicteksystems@gmail.com with /contact citation)

day1_failed_queries_evaluation.routing_decision: Deterministic Negative Boundary Fallback (Clarifies digital-first consultancy, no physical office published)

day1_failed_queries_evaluation.user_query: Can I get a project estimate?
day1_failed_queries_evaluation.day1_failure_root_cause: Lexical overlap on 'estimate' matched consumer budgeting guides instead of XICTEK consulting intake.

day1_failed_queries_evaluation.user_query: What phone number should I call for XICTEK?

day1_failed_queries_evaluation.routing_decision: Deterministic Negative Boundary Fallback (Phone number not published; direct to Contact Us form)

day1_failed_queries_evaluation.user_query: What are your maintenance response times and support hours?
